review_candidates.title: Controller
review_candidates.description: Farheap Solutions, Inc. is seeking a highly skilled and experienced Financial Controller to join our global team. This is a fully remote role open to candidates worldwide, with some required overlap with the PST time zone. The role also offers the potential to progress to CFO based on performance and capabilities. Company Description: Farheap Solutions is a technology-focused company overseeing multiple business units in software engineering, eCommerce, printing, and manufacturing. Company is committed to maintaining top performance across its online platforms and enhancing its capacity to capture revenue. As the Financial Controller, you will play a pivotal role in overseeing our financial operations, ensuring accurate accounting, reporting, effective financial management, and strategic decision-making. Your leadership abilities will be crucial in managing and guiding our finance team towards achieving departmental and organisational goals. Please note that even though this is #workfromanywhere position and we offer substantial flexibility, some overlap with PST zone business hours is needed. Key Responsibilities ✔ Financial Leadership: Provide strategic financial guidance to senior management and department heads, translating financial data into actionable insights to support business objectives and growth strategies. ✔ Financial Reporting: Oversee the preparation and presentation of timely, accurate, and comprehensive financial statements, reports, and analyses. Ensure compliance with US GAAP and, where applicable, IFRS, as well as relevant accounting standards and regulations across all operating jurisdictions. ✔ Budgeting and Forecasting: Lead the budgeting and forecasting processes, collaborating with department heads to develop realistic financial plans aligned with strategic goals. Monitor performance against budgets and provide variance analysis. ✔ Cash Flow Management: Manage cash flow, liquidity, and working capital to optimize financial stability and support operational needs. Implement effective cash flow forecasting and management techniques. ✔ Risk Management: Identify and mitigate financial risks through comprehensive risk assessments, internal controls, and compliance measures. Stay current with regulatory changes that may impact financial operations. ✔ Team Leadership: Lead and develop accounting team, fostering a culture of collaboration, continuous learning, and high performance. Provide coaching, mentorship, and guidance to team members. ✔ Process Enhancement: Continuously assess and improve accounting processes, systems, and controls to enhance efficiency, accuracy, and effectiveness. Implement best practices and drive process automation where applicable. ✔ Financial Analysis: Conduct in-depth financial analyses, including profitability, cost analysis, ROI assessments, and trend analysis. Present findings to senior management and recommend strategic actions. ✔ Tax Compliance & Reporting (US & Europe): Own the preparation, review, and timely filing of US federal, state, and local tax returns (corporate income tax, sales & use tax, franchise tax), in coordination with external tax advisors and auditors. Oversee VAT compliance across European entities, including VAT registration, periodic VAT returns, OSS, reverse-charge mechanisms, and intra-EU/cross-border transaction treatment. Qualifications and Skills 💡 Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, or a related field. MBA or CPA designation is preferred. 💡 Managerial Experience: A minimum of 5 years of demonstrated leadership experience in finance, including managing and developing a team. 💡 Previous experience working with US companies 💡 Knowledge of IFRS/US GAAP 💡 Advanced English (C1/C2) 💡 Financial Expertise: Strong understanding of accounting principles, financial reporting, budgeting, and financial analysis. Experience working in fully remote setting is considered a bonus. 💡 ERP and Tools: Good experience with accounting software, preferably with Microsoft Business Central; advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel. 🎯 If you are a strategic financial leader with exceptional managerial skills and a passion for driving financial excellence, we encourage you to apply. Join us in shaping the future of our organization through effective financial management and leadership.

review_candidates.title: Communications Specialist
review_candidates.description: WHO ARE WE? The Danish Refugee Council assists refugees and internally displaced persons across the globe: we provide emergency aid, fight for their rights, and strengthen their opportunity for a brighter future. We work in conflict-affected areas, along the displacement routes, and in the countries where refugees settle. In cooperation with local communities, we strive for responsible and sustainable solutions. We work toward successful integration and – whenever possible – for the fulfillment of the wish to return home. The Danish Refugee Council was founded in Denmark in 1956, and has since grown to become an international humanitarian organization with more than 7,000 staff and 8,000 volunteers. Our vision is a dignified life for all displaced. All of our efforts are based on our value compass: humanity, respect, independence and neutrality, participation, and honesty and transparency. About The Job The communications specialist promotes DRC's mission, mandate, work and influencing strategies in country, working closely with management teams to identify appropriate methods to communicate to relevant parties. The Communications Specialist will support the visibility, positioning and external communications of DRC in Afghanistan by producing high-quality, timely and context-sensitive communications materials that demonstrate DRC’s program, impact, expertise and priorities. Working closely under supervision of with the Advocacy and Communications Coordinator and in collaboration with program teams, Area Offices and relevant support functions, the Specialist will coordinate day-to-day communications activities, develop written and multimedia content, support media engagement, ensure donor visibility requirements are followed, and strengthen communications capacity across DRC in Afghanistan. The role will contribute to DRC’s objective of strengthening its visibility and credibility as a leading humanitarian actor on displacement. Responsibilities: Communications planning and coordination Support the Advocacy and Communications Coordinator in developing and implementing annual communications plan. Coordinate day-to-day communications activities across the Offices in Afghanistan. Maintain a communications calendar linked to program milestones, humanitarian events, donor priorities and DRC global communications opportunities. Work proactively with program teams to identify strong stories, results, evidence, photographs and communications opportunities. Coordinate Afghanistan content with relevant DRC Hub and Global Communications colleagues. Support timely internal information sharing so that potential communications opportunities from field operations are identified and developed. Content development and storytelling Develop high-quality communications products including but not limited to: human-interest and impact stories, program and project briefs, factsheets, web articles and blogs, newsletters, social media content, photographs and short videos, infographics and other visual materials, communications inputs to situation reports and external publications. Translate complex program information, data and technical analysis into clear and accessible communications products. Ensure storytelling respects the dignity, agency, informed consent and protection of affected people. Promote the voices and perspectives of displacement-affected communities and local partners. Digital communications and visibility Produce and coordinate Afghanistan-related content for appropriate DRC digital and social media channels. Maintain an organized repository of quality photographs, videos, stories, consent documentation and communications materials. Ensure materials consistently follow DRC branding, communications standards and approved messaging. Support dissemination of Afghanistan content through DRC global and other relevant organizational channels. Monitor communications performance and identify opportunities to improve reach, quality and engagement. Media and external communications support Support the Advocacy and Communications Coordinator in responding to national and international media requests. Maintain and periodically update relevant media contacts and information. Prepare background information, key messages, media briefs and communications materials for interviews. Support preparation of the Country Director and other designated spokespersons for media engagements. Monitor relevant Afghan and international media coverage and identify communications opportunities and emerging reputational issues. Support communications arrangements for high-level visits, donor visits, public events and external engagements. Donor and program visibility Work with programs, grants and partnership colleagues to identify communications and visibility requirements in donor-funded projects. Support teams in preparing project-specific communications and visibility plans where required. Ensure donor-funded communications materials appropriately acknowledge donor contributions and comply with applicable visibility commitments. Maintain an overview of planned and completed donor visibility products. Support project teams in developing donor-facing evidence of program achievements and impact. Field communications capacity and quality assurance Provide practical guidance and coaching to Area Office and program colleagues responsible for collecting communications content. Support colleagues to apply DRC standards for ethical storytelling, branding and donor visibility. Review field-generated communications materials and provide technical feedback. Help establish a network of communications focal points across Afghanistan to improve the regular flow of quality content. About You To be successful in this role you must have: Experience and technical competencies: Minimum 3 years of relevant professional experience working in communications, media, and public information preferably within humanitarian and development sector. Demonstrated ability to produce high-quality communications content for different audiences. Excellent writing, editing and storytelling skills. Experience and demonstrated ability to produce high-quality communications materials including stories, publications, photographs, social media content and digital content for different audiences. Good understanding of ethical storytelling, safeguarding, informed consent and conflict-sensitive communications. Ability to communicate complex humanitarian and program issues clearly and accurately. Ability to work independently, manage competing deadlines and deliver quality outputs in a complex operational environment. Strong interpersonal and coordination skills. Education/qualifications: Bachelor's degree in communication, journalism, political science, international development or other relevant field. Languages: Advanced professional level in English Fluent in Dari and Pashto We Offer: Salary and conditions will be in accordance with DRC salary scale Application process: Application process: Interested? Then apply for this position by clicking on the below link. All applicants must send a cover letter and an updated CV (no longer than four pages). Both must be in the same language. Note. only applications ( CV) will not be considered. Note: This position will be advertised on a rolling basis. We will begin the recruitment process as soon as we receive a suitable number of applications.

Do you take ownership without being asked, and stay calm when everything's on fire? Reliability and a genuine interest in growing long-term, not a short-term gig.

review_candidates.title: CRM Automation Specialist
review_candidates.description: Job Description Are you ready to shape customer relevance at scale by leveraging data, insights, and automation to deliver highly personalised experiences at the moments that matter most? As a CRM Automation Specialist , you will play a key role in designing, running, and continuously optimising our portfolio of automated and triggered CRM journeys. This role goes beyond execution. You will actively help define how automation and lifecycle journeys drive conversion, retention, loyalty, and long‑term customer value. You will work hands‑on with journeys while thinking strategically about customer behaviour, lifecycle progression, and commercial impact. Triggered communication is a key growth area for us, and in this role you will directly contribute to increasing its share of overall CRM value by strengthening always‑on journeys and improving their effectiveness over time. In this role, you will: Build, operate, and continuously optimise automated, data‑triggered CRM journeys across email, push and other owned channels. Own the end‑to‑end lifecycle of CRM journeys: setup, testing, launch, iteration, and ongoing optimisation. Translate performance insights, test results, and customer behaviour data into clear optimisation actions that improve engagement, retention, and revenue. Support the evolution of our lifecycle and automation strategy, ensuring journeys drive long‑term customer value, not just short‑term results. Collaborate closely with local markets to adapt and localise global CRM journeys, improving relevance and performance while maintaining consistency. Strengthen loyalty and membership engagement by turning initiatives into relevant, timely, and value‑adding CRM experiences. Ensure high‑quality execution while safeguarding relevance, customer value, and brand consistency across markets. Actively explore new automation, segmentation, and personalisation opportunities to raise the impact of our always‑on CRM portfolio. WHO YOU’LL WORK WITH You will be part of our Global CRM team, working closely with CRM Strategist, Data Scientists, Creative teams, Marketing Technology, and platform partners, while reporting to the CRM Manager. Together, you will ensure that our always‑on journeys and CRM communications work together to deliver impactful, customer‑centred experiences that support both engagement and commercial growth across our owned channels. WHO YOU ARE We are looking for someone who combines strong hands‑on CRM execution skills with a curiosity for optimisation, data, and customer behaviour - and who enjoys owning journeys end to end. You are comfortable working close to the details while also understanding how automated CRM contributes to retention, loyalty, and long‑term customer value. We believe you have: A Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Economics, Communication, or a related field. 2-5 years of experience within CRM execution, lifecycle marketing, or marketing automation. Hands‑on experience building and running automated CRM journeys in platforms such as Braze, Salesforce, Klaviyo, MoEngage, or similar. Strong ability to analyse journey performance and customer data, and turn insights into clear optimisation opportunities that drive incremental value. Confidence presenting recommendations, insights, and learnings within a large, cross‑functional organisation. An analytical mindset and eagerness to test, learn, and continuously improve customer journeys and automation setups. And you are someone who is: Highly detail‑oriented, structured, and reliable in execution. Comfortable collaborating across disciplines, regions, and markets. A clear and confident communicator, with strong written and spoken English skills. Curious, proactive, and motivated by improving customer experiences and lifecycle performance over. time and improving our standards when it comes to AI & personalization. WHO WE ARE H&M Group is a global company of strong fashion brands and ventures. Our goal is to prove that there is no compromise between exceptional design, affordable prices, and sustainable solutions. We want to liberate fashion for the many, and our customers are at the heart of every decision we make. We are made up of thousands of passionate and talented colleagues united by our shared culture and values. Together, we want to use our power, our scale, and our knowledge to push the fashion industry towards a more inclusive and sustainable future. WHY YOU’LL LOVE WORKING HERE At H&M Group, we are proud to be a vibrant and welcoming company. We offer our employees attractive benefits and extensive development opportunities across the globe. You’ll be part of a collaborative environment where your ideas matter, and where you can grow your expertise within CRM, data‑driven marketing, and global communication. JOIN US Our uniqueness comes from a combination of many things - our inclusive and collaborative culture, our strong values, and opportunities for growth. But most of all, it’s our people who make us who we are. This is a full-time position based in Stockholm . Please apply as soon as possible by submitting your CV in English. Due to data privacy regulations, we only accept applications through our career page. We are committed to a recruitment process that is fair, equitable, and based on competency. We therefore kindly ask you to not attach a cover letter in your application.

Together with GZERO Media—the go-to source of first insight into geopolitics—and our full-fledged events team, the Eurasia Group umbrella provides a complete political risk solution. Headquartered in New York, we have offices in Washington, London, São Paulo, Brasilia, Tokyo, Singapore, and San Francisco, as well as on-the-ground experts in more than a hundred countries in every region of the world. We are committed to analysis that is free of political bias and the influence of private interests. Visit us: eurasiagroup.net | gzeromedia.com Follow us: LinkedIn | X | Threads | Facebook | Instagram | YouTube Position Overview The Business Analytics team is seeking a mid-level Data Analyst with strong business acumen and SQL skills to deliver high-impact insights and build scalable solutions. This role blends technical execution (data development, automation, dashboards) with financial and commercial goals (financial analysis, interpreting results, supporting data driven decision-making). The ideal candidate is a self-starter who is comfortable operating independently, partnering directly with business stakeholders, and taking ownership of analytical solutions from development through deployment. Key Responsibilities Business Partnership Partner with Finance and other stakeholders to turn vaguely-formed ideas into business questions with clear goals, deliverables, and success metrics. Identify trends, risks, and opportunities through data analysis. Develop dashboards within Power BI and present findings and recommendations to technical and non-technical audiences. Data & Analytics Development Design, build, and maintain scalable data models, reporting layers, and analytical solutions using SQL and dbt. Develop and deploy production-ready code through Git-based workflows and standard CI/CD processes. Independently troubleshoot data issues, improve data quality, and resolve discrepancies across source systems, transformations, and reporting layers.
